message.content: {"question":"Two satellites are placed in circular orbits of equal radius, one around the Earth and the other around the Moon. Which statement is correct?","options":{"A":"The terrestrial satellite makes one turn in a longer time than the lunar satellite","B":"The terrestrial satellite makes one revolution at the same time as the lunar satellite","C":"The terrestrial satellite makes one turn in a shorter time than the lunar satellite","D":"To answer you must know the masses of the satellites"},"correct":"C"}
